about: PalCraft systems: one behaviour each, with the sheets it reads.

rows.description: First start: read the player's Palworld into the instance's palcraft folder (models, textures, names, elements); later starts reuse it
Draw each Pal with its own Palworld mesh and textures, scaled to its hitbox, with a little walk bob
Pals show their Palworld name and element
Pals spawn in their biomes; a new world puts a few of each near the player
First join in a world gives starterCount Pal Spheres
Thrown Pal Sphere: chance = catchBase x (1.5 - health fraction); success stores the Pal in the sphere
Use a filled sphere to send the Pal out: it follows you and attacks what you attack or what attacks you. Use an empty sphere on your Pal to recall it
Pal Sphere uses Palworld's own Pal Sphere icon once extracted (bundled plain icon until then)
